The class has 2 members but my `class_members` only stored the *representative* (first), not all members! That's the bug: `class_members.setdefault(pmask, []).append(rep)` — appends only the representative literal set. I need to append every eligible clause.

Let me fix: build `class_members[pmask]` as a list of all member clause literal-tuples.

Also fix the column_counts weight overflow.
